title: Report: Ex-Canes DE Bain drove in fatal car crash

sources.name: ESPN NFL
sources.title: Report: Ex-Canes DE Bain drove in fatal car crash
sources.description: Former Miami defensive end and 2026 NFL draft prospect Rueben Bain Jr. was involved in an auto accident in 2024 in which a passenger later died because of injuries sustained in the crash, according to a report published on Sunday.
